guardrail: Only exact tariffs explicitly bound by an official operator source to direct/ad-hoc charging are promoted. Contract/subscriber prices and station samples are not generalized.

cpos.operator: Städtische Werke Magdeburg GmbH & Co. KG

directTariff.notes: Official SWM page states the SMS charging price is 61.00 ct/kWh gross from 2026-09-01. The page describes the complete SMS start/stop and mobile-bill payment flow and does not publish an additional session or blocking component for this method.

cpos.scopeNote: Do not substitute the separate SWM Mobil RFID subscription tariff (49.90 ct/kWh plus annual fee) for direct SMS charging.

cpos.operator: eins energie in sachsen GmbH & Co. KG

directTariff.notes: Official current operator page has a dedicated 'Ad-Hoc Preise' table for eins charging stations and publishes exact Fair-Use rules.

cpos.scopeNote: Subscriber E-Mobil S/M/L prices are separate products and are not used as the ad-hoc tariff.

verifiedFacts: Official EVH page confirms spontaneous ad-hoc access to EVH public charging stations through the charge it easy app with a payment method such as credit card.
The numeric table on the same page belongs to Halplus Strom / MOBIL+ and includes a monthly service price, so it is not promoted as a contract-free direct tariff without a stronger binding statement.

The subscriber/local table valid from 2025-08-22 publishes 52/57 ct/kWh depending on EVH customer status and 5 ct/min from 30 minutes after charge end between 08:00 and 20:00, but those values remain product-scoped.
cpos.neededToComplete: Resolve the current charge it easy public ad-hoc checkout/app tariff after EVSE selection, or an official EVH/LichtBlick station-level feed that explicitly binds the numeric direct price and blocking rule to each EVSE.
